title: AgentFlow — Workflows & integrations
description: Workflow ingest, actions, webhooks and ticks.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.outcome'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'workflow.ingest' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.integration.provider'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name IN ('webhook.integration', 'webhook.github') AND has_error = true AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, concat(attributes_string['af.workflow.action'], ':', attributes_string['af.outcome']) AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'workflow.action_run' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'workflow.action_run' AND attributes_string['af.outcome'] = 'retry' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.outcome'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'integration.connection_test' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, name AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name LIKE 'workflow.tick.%' AND has_error = true AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, name AS label, quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name LIKE 'workflow.tick.%' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts
